cases.source: Provide CRUD operations and calculate the total order amount.
assumptions: The total order amount is assumed to be calculated as quantity × unit price, but this is not explicitly stated in the requirements.
The creation of an order item is assumed, but the requirements do not specify whether order items are created as part of order creation or require separate handling.

cases.source: Provide CRUD operations and calculate the total order amount.
assumptions: The requirements do not specify what happens to the order total or product stock when status is updated to completed.
No mention of whether the total amount is recalculated or if any side effects occur.

ambiguities: The requirements do not specify whether deleting an order removes associated order items or updates product stock.
No information is provided about what happens to the order status after deletion or whether it is set to 'deleted' or removed entirely.

cases.source: A product can appear in multiple orders.
ambiguities: The requirements do not specify whether product stock decreases when a product is added to an order.
The value 4 is assumed as a decrement of 1, but the quantity used in the order is not specified or linked to the stock change.
